title: Cheque Check
description: Stops a cheque being deposited after it expires, before its date or with a correction clearing will reject, by reading the date the way it's written in the CTS boxes (so 31 November is caught), showing the safe deposit window under RBI's 3-month rule and warning on the disputed last day, catching a January cheque still carrying last year's date and a two-digit year, and saying when Positive Pay is needed, with one-tap date fixes.
stops: Cheque bounced as expired or post-dated
